name: payment-provider-flow-audit-20260710
title: Harden MoMo and VNPAY payment flow and simplify restaurant payment UI
description: Audit the live payment path, align VNPAY callback handling with the provider contract, preserve MoMo behavior, and remove sandbox environment controls from the restaurant manager UI.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Official-provider review found that VNPAY requires GMT+7 timestamps, vnp_ExpireDate, GET IPN with RspCode/Message, HMAC-SHA512 in the current Node sample, and both response and transaction status for success. The manager UI must not expose sandbox/production terminology.
